tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use rustls as the TLS backend, chosen as a pure Rust implementation that avoids the CVE exposure of the previous choice. Certificate verification stays on in every build, development included, and plain HTTP is allowed only for internal hosts; all other traffic remains under TLS with verification enabled.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md
